title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 065 ]

blocks.text: In order to avoid the greenhouse effect, we have to find other sources of energy. They have to be clean and less expensive. Scientists think that one such source is solar energy. It can be used to produce electricity, which can then be used to run cars and fly airplanes. Now we should take steps to find clean energy.

readingSentences.english: In order to avoid the greenhouse effect, we have to find other sources of energy.
readingSentences.korean: 온실효과를 피하기 위해 우리는 다른 에너지원을 찾아야만 한다.

readingSentences.english: They have to be clean and less expensive.
Scientists think that one such source is solar energy.
readingSentences.korean: 과학자들은 한가지 그러한 에너지는 태양열 에너지라고 생각한다.

readingSentences.english: It can be used to produce electricity, which can then be used to run cars and fly airplanes.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 전기를 생산하는데 사용될수 있고 그것은 그리고 나서 차를 운행하고 비행기를 날리는데 사용될수 있다.

readingSentences.english: Now we should take steps to find clean energy.
readingSentences.korean: 지금은 우리는 청정 에너지를 찾기 위해 조치를 취해야만 한다.
